definitions.explanation: A Japanese street food made from batter cooked in a fish-shaped (specifically sea bream) mold, typically filled with sweet red bean paste. Other common fillings include custard, chocolate, and cheese.

⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼きたて：16735_yakitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鯛焼|たいや}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パリッとしていた→パリッとする：26984_parittosuru⟧。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧ (sea bream, a fish of celebration) + ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (baked): named after the shape of the mold.

CULTURAL NOTE:
A popular street and festival snack. The classic filling is ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧ (sweet red bean paste); custard, chocolate and savory fillings are modern variations. Whether to start from the head or the tail is a long-running joke debate.
